reasons: The cited §18.1 matches the preferred position line by line: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, plus term-plus-one-year duration.
§18.2 supplies certificates/evidence on request and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities, satisfying the remaining preferred elements.

Obligations run against Vendor (Copperleaf) and benefit Customer (Meridian), so no redline or comment is needed for a compliant finding; deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present.
